releaseModel: single current machine contract containing seven embedded accepted semantic surfaces; history and prior packaging live in Git/issues, not parallel contract files

anonymousForm.identity: local syntactic occurrence within one interpretation

memory.model: finite explicit local ordered-pair store; local LinkRef values are storage coordinates, not semantic identity

excluded: runtime handle or source position as semantic Link identity
generic proof DAG or top-level judgment dependency semantics
unrestricted equality transitivity, symmetry or congruence
hidden interpreter-focus identity as evaluation input
existing-aset ANUM carrier theorem before issue #333 acceptance
persistent backend as canonical semantic dependency

anum.purpose: Pure denotation of one raw/channel quaternary Anum stream by the explicit stack machine established after semantic reset #343. This is an operational stream subset, not acceptance of Foundation v2 or a universal theorem about every possible Anum carrier.

streamInterpreter.state: stack of frames; each frame has started:boolean and current:Link
streamInterpreter.OPEN: push current frame; create new frame(started=false,current=R)
streamInterpreter.VALUE: if frame.started=false then current=value and started=true; otherwise current=Link(current,value)
streamInterpreter.CLOSE: pop non-root frame; inner = current when started else R; returned = Link(R,inner) when started else R; feed returned to parent through VALUE
streamInterpreter.FINISH: root frame must be the only frame; result = current when started else R

valueBundle.foundation: typed L2 Form plus explicit read-only MemoryView; the accepted flat-bundle operation is self-contained below and does not inherit a historical MTS umbrella

operatorDomains.standaloneValueEntry: flat ValueBundle allowed when value context is explicit
operatorDomains.definitionRhs: existing scalar Form or ConstraintBundle only; ValueBundle deferred

rules.when: all non-empty direct items are Judgments
all non-empty direct items are non-bundle Forms in a value-capable context
direct items mix Judgment and Form evidence
empty {} occurs in a statically value-capable position
empty {} is the constraint interpretation entry expression
non-empty ValueBundle is a definition RHS
ValueBundle appears under scalar-only ⟼/♀/♂/¬ operand position
empty {} has no static role context
a ValueBundle directly contains another ValueBundle/CurlySyntax item

scalar.identity: canonical semantic Link resolved by the runtime memory view

bundle.identity: extensional set of unique resolved semantic Links

elementResolution.unresolvedAnonymousOccurrence: evaluation-unresolved/failure; never choose an arbitrary link

historicalAnonymousClaim.conditional: true only when independently resolved semantic-link sets are equal

expansionQuery.trigger: Sequence/juxtaposition with exactly two endpoints and at least one statically elaborated ValueBundle operand
expansionQuery.result: flat ValueBundle of existing semantic Links

endpointDomains.emptyBundle: wildcard only in expansion endpoint position

operations.emptyToEmpty: all existing links in selected memory view
operations.constrainedToConstrained: existing exact links whose ordered poles belong to the two endpoint domains

deferred.bundleValuedDefinitions: requires a tagged value environment/binding contract
deferred.bundleProjectionOrInversion: requires an explicit lifting rule or rejection in a later accepted surface
deferred.bundleAsExplicitLinkFormPole: requires a separate lifting decision; current expansion uses juxtaposition only
deferred.explicitBundleMaterialization: separate L4 operation if ever needed

definitionOpening.foundation: typed scalar Form plus explicit lexical DefinitionEnvironment; the accepted one-step operation is self-contained below and does not inherit a historical MTS umbrella
definitionOpening.scope: normative one-step read-only definition opening semantics; trusted proof rules remain a separate surface

addressability.rule: a definition target is addressable only when its typed scalar Form contains neither occurrence-local anonymous empty [] nor ContextPronoun nodes
addressability.bundleTarget: non-addressable under the accepted scalar definition-target boundary
addressability.reason: occurrence-local/deictic forms must not become global definition names merely because two ASTs have the same structural spelling

results.no-match: no visible definition for addressable target
results.conflict: same-scope duplicate target makes that nearest lexical target conflicting rather than falling back to a parent
results.non-addressable: target is outside the accepted addressable subset

bodySemantics.returnedValue: the exact typed RHS Expression registered by the selected Definition introduction

recursion.self: a : a opens once to a and stops
recursion.mutual: a : b opens once to b; opening b is another explicit operation

productionIntegration.reasonInterpretRemainsSeparate: accepted opening is a definition operation, not a new interpretation branch

derivationBase.foundation: self-contained primitive derivation relations defined by independent replay of the canonical operations named below; no historical MTS umbrella or proof release is part of relation identity
derivationBase.scope: accepted primitive typed derivation relations backed by independent replay of canonical operations; no multi-step composition rules

judgmentShape.subject: all operation inputs required by the relation
judgmentShape.evidence: validated OperationalReplayClaim for the exact canonical operation

relations.meaning: the expression satisfies the accepted contextual interpretation semantics under exactly these replay inputs
the visible definition selected by this exact lexical environment opens the target once to this exact RHS
no visible definition for the target exists in this exact finite lexical environment snapshot
the nearest relevant lexical scope in this environment contains a same-target definition conflict
the target is outside the accepted definition-addressability subset

negativeRelationBoundary.reason: each accepted negative relation names the exact finite scope/subset in which the negative result was replayed; no global absence or closed-world conclusion is introduced

openingPath.foundation: self-contained finite composition of the accepted one-step DefinitionOpening operation; historical proof or umbrella releases are not semantic dependencies
openingPath.scope: normative read-only verification of one finite self-contained DefinitionOpeningPath operational composite certificate; no equality, normalization, evaluation, generic composition, memory or context effects

typedCore.environmentArgument: DefinitionEnvironment already representing the explicit lookup scope
typedCore.comparison: typed structural_key equality; SourceSpan/display text are not semantic identity

portableCertificate.scopes: explicit lexical DefinitionEnvironment snapshot used by the canonical one-step opening operation
portableCertificate.lookupScope: one exact serialized scope path used for every edge
portableCertificate.startTarget: parseable Form source; structural identity after parsing

edges.target: parseable Form source; structural identity after parsing; equivalent whitespace allowed
edges.body: canonical format_expression transport of the expected replay body

portableCertificate.finalBody: canonical format_expression transport of the final expected replay body
portableCertificate.reason: transport validation belongs to the consuming artifact layer; every consumer must construct the same typed witness and invoke the one canonical verifier

verificationOrder: check first edge target structurally matches startTarget
for each later edge require previous replay body is Form and structurally equals next target
require replay body structurally equals expected typed edge body
after exact serialized edge count require last replay body structurally equals finalBody

cycleCanonicality.mutualCycleCanonicalWitness: one edge per distinct DefinitionId until repetition

proof.foundation: current trusted proof artifact over two self-contained semantic leaves: the five primitive derivation relations and the finite DefinitionOpeningPath verifier; no historical proof or umbrella release is a semantic parent; proofObject.contractVersion remains only a transport discriminator and does not reintroduce an umbrella dependency
proof.purpose: Trusted independent replay of exactly five primitive derivation relations plus the accepted finite DefinitionOpeningPath operational composite certificate; no other composition or inference rule is accepted.

proofObject.judgments: ordered V04Judgment[]; array order is artifact order only and has no generic premise/dependency meaning

definitionOpeningPath.lookupScope: one exact serialized scope path used for every opening edge
definitionOpeningPath.startTarget: parseable Form source; structural identity after parsing; equivalent whitespace permitted

edges.target: parseable Form source; structural identity after parsing; equivalent whitespace permitted
edges.body: exact canonical format_expression transport parsed into typed Expression

definitionOpeningPath.finalBody: exact canonical format_expression transport parsed into typed Expression

serialization.canonicalTargetSerialization: format_expression; decoder additionally accepts structurally equivalent target whitespace

directDeixis.foundation: one typed L2 Expression; this structural analysis is self-contained below and does not inherit a historical MTS umbrella
directDeixis.scope: normative read-only structural detection of explicit ContextPronoun occurrences in one typed L2 Expression; no evaluation, dependency closure, sensitivity or invariance theorem

operation.name: analyze_direct_deixis

occurrence.path: structural typed-AST path of non-negative integers

operation.ordering: deterministic preorder, equivalent to lexicographic structural path order for this tree traversal

meaningBoundary.positiveResultMeans: the typed AST directly contains the reported explicit context-pronoun occurrences
meaningBoundary.emptyResultMeans: the typed AST contains no direct ContextPronoun occurrence

interpreterBoundary.reason: direct deixis is a property of the typed expression structure, not of one interpreter instance or one runtime context
